title: The Grothendieck ring of a non-divisible ordered abelian group is trivial
summary: We consider the model-theoretic Grothendieck ring of definable sets in ordered abelian groups. It is well-known that $\mathrm{K} \mathbb{Q} \cong \mathbb{Z}[T]/(T^2 + T)$ and $\mathrm{K} \mathbb{Z} =0$, but surprisingly little is known about other cases. We present a short computation which shows that they all collapse: $\mathrm{K} G = 0$, unless $G$ is divisible.
